layer.name: Structural complaints
layer.description: DOB complaints in the structural categories: adjacent building not protected (03), excavation undermining (14), inadequate shoring (16), structural stability (30), retaining wall (54), structurally compromised (2K), new building stability (5C). A complaint is a report, not a finding; each shows DOB's disposition with its date when one is recorded. Complaints entered from 2024-01-01 on. Not on the map: 1,470 of 18,051 complaints (the building has no footprint or lot point, or a placeholder BIN). Category wording is from DOB's printed list, imported by hand and not yet checked by a second person. Not added to 311 requests, which can repeat a complaint. Pulled 2026-11-14.
